sections.section_title: HDP general purpose output value register (HDP_GPOVAL)
sections.text_helper: Section 77.4.6 "HDP general purpose output value register (HDP_GPOVAL)" in chapter 77 (Hardware debug port (HDP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 4371.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x01C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 HDPGPOVAL[7:0]: When written, define the value of the HDP GPO.
When read, provide the current GPO value.

fields.name: Res.
